specs.title: B14 keyboard only: Change opens a modal with focus inside, Tab is trapped, the page behind is inert, Escape closes without applying and focus returns
B14 closing never applies: Escape, Close and the backdrop discard typed facts; Apply and Cancel put focus somewhere sensible
B14 if the opener is gone when the sheet closes, focus lands on a surviving control, never on <body>
B14 names and states: each night's controls are distinct; plan status, stale previews, conflicts and outstanding groceries are identifiable
B14 announcements: one per real change; routine refetches, polls and own reads announce nothing; only one live region
B14 background and return with a stale preview open in the sheet: focus stays in the sheet, Apply stays disabled, discarding returns focus
B14 grocery review during a dinner change: the reviewer keeps focus, sees the delta, and hears it once
B14 sheet at 320px with 150% text: fits, scrolls inside itself, never under the nav or header
B14 sheet at 390px with 150% text: fits, scrolls inside itself, never under the nav or header
B14 reduced motion: the sheet does not animate when the member asks for reduced motion
B12: Alex makes a different yogurt the usual; Jon sees it live; the purchase still needs its own approval
T01: Jon previews Friday while Alex reviews groceries, then cancels — nothing accepted changes
T08: Alex changes Friday while Jon's Friday preview is open — Jon sees it without pressing Apply
T09: same as T08 while Jon's app is backgrounded; the newer decision and stale draft appear on return
T10: concurrent independent Friday and Sunday replacements — Jon (Sunday) commits first
T10: concurrent independent Friday and Sunday replacements — Alex (Friday) commits first
T11: concurrent replacements of Friday — Jon first
T11: concurrent replacements of Friday — Alex first
T12: adopting an old whole-week proposal after a newer accepted change stops and shows the current week
Reload preserves accepted state, previews and stale status (persistence, not browser memory)
T22: Wednesday and Thursday edits interact through the leftover source — Wednesday first
T22: Wednesday and Thursday edits interact through the leftover source — Thursday first
T15: a double-clicked Apply records one change
T02: Jon proposes, Alex adopts the displayed week; one accepted plan, no order/cooking/eating records
T03: Sounds good, preferences, favorites and notes persist without changing the accepted week
T04: a Wednesday preview shows Thursday's leftover consequence; a locked Thursday blocks it; cancel changes nothing
T05: dinners covered while a price is unknown — meals chosen, groceries and budget not asserted
T06: after adoption Home shows the next dinner and real work; Cook and Reheat open the right instructions; Also need is reachable
T07: less left than planned makes Thursday unresolved without replacing it
T13: Jon's Friday change reaches Alex's open grocery review as a delta; unaffected approvals stay; stale Send makes zero calls
T14/T20: simulated send, order confirmed with different contents, then a Friday change and receipt exceptions
T16: an uncertain transfer is shown as uncertain with a cart check, and is not resent
T18: repeated staple taps from Week, Groceries and Cook merge with names; an explicit extra stays extra
T21: editing a recipe in the library keeps the accepted dinner on its pinned version
R-F01-UI: an incomplete proposal is shown as a draft and cannot be adopted (UI and server)
R-F07-UI: Also need works before next week's dinners are chosen, and both members see it
R-F06-UI: Have enough records the amount shown on screen
Header overlap: at phone width the sticky header never covers a night's controls, at the top or scrolled
X01: unauthenticated and other-household sessions cannot read or write this household
X10: discovery — focus-stable search, real sorts with an unknown group, opening the selected recipe, persisted notes
X11: narrow mobile layout, keyboard operation, text scaling, distinct identities
X02: server restart, missed events and a delayed older response cannot roll back accepted state
X05: the server dies after dispatch started; on restart the transfer is uncertain and never replayed
